provenance.prompt:
Draw fifteen SMALL, complete, fully visible full-body action poses in a 5-column × 3-row transparent sprite sheet. Each person is centered in their own cell and no body part crosses its cell boundary. Leave at least 10% of cell width empty to left and right of every person. The outermost left/right figures must have at least 10% empty margin to canvas edges. Keep arms bent and close to torso so they fit. Solid transparent RGBA outside characters; no background, no court, no floor, no shadow, no lines, no panels, no rim, no ball, no props, no text.

The same Dorian Mycel as in both attached reference images: clean-shaven adult compact-athletic human, warm medium-brown skin, strong brows, short dense vivid-purple curls, purple Chicago Condas jersey and shorts, silver/lavender trim, dark knee pads, purple wristbands, purple/silver shoes. Preserve identity exactly, never beard or headband, no teal hair or kit. Each person has two arms, two hands, two legs and shoes. Right-facing basketball power dunk, mime only an invisible separate basketball: 0 bent approach; 1 forward drive; 2 gathers empty hands; 3 plant; 4 takeoff; 5 rises with knees tucked; 6 climbs and brings empty right hand upward; 7 extends right arm; 8 peak high reach; 9 still airborne and reaches up, arm bent so within cell; 10 downward scoring finish; 11 follows through; 12 descends; 13 lands in crouch; 14 stable standing recovery. 15 unique connected poses, exact row-major order, clear bold 90s arcade pixel art outline. Small uniform figure scale and enough transparent empty space around everyone. Return only the sheet.

provenance.ballPolicy: Dorian-specific separate basketball follows the ball-miming body motion and releases/grabs on the reviewed event frame. Never paint a ball into the poses. Track length: 15.

cleanup.method: alpha-connected component isolation and nearest-pixel reassignment

review.reviewNotes: 15 distinct complete Dorian dunk-power poses. Warm brown skin, short dense vivid-purple curls, compact adult human anatomy, strong brows and the purple/silver Chicago Condas kit remain consistent. The separate Dorian ball follows the documented dunk-power track.
